data.content_ref: inline:SRC_002's reduction asserts that verify_root_report's root-version handler lacks an explicit pre-v6 branch, so those roots fall through a default verdict path. But its own refutation condition exposes the core unsupported move: the claim that there is NO explicit pre-v6 branch is stronger than anything in the endpoints warrants. The endpoints establish only that the three pre-v6 roots are misclassified (sweep sees ERROR, direct-load sees verdict); that observation is equally consistent with a branch that EXISTS but has defective logic — e.g., a pre-v6 case that matches the metadata yet returns the wrong classification. SRC_002 never rules out the branch-presence counter-possibility, so the 'missing branch' reduction is not determined by the evidence; it is one of at least two compatible causal stories. A reduction that fails to exclude a live alternative explanation for the same observable delta is not a substantive reduction to a type-dispatch defect.
